recentItems.description:
LAND OF SILENCE AND DARKNESS | Werner Herzog | Arthouse, Documentary https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLBrrfZs-ew7P0N9nUwg_mdvgfMP37hXJr

Through examining Fini Straubinger, an old woman who has been deaf and blind since adolescence, this film shows how the deaf and blind struggle to understand and accept a world from which they are almost wholly isolated. Directed by Werner Herzog, Land Of Silence And Darkness stars Fini Straubinger, M. Baaske, Elsa Fehrer, Heinrich Fleischmann, Rolf Illig, Vladimir Kokol, Resi Mittermeier, Gustav Heinemann, and more.
